Texas RRC Class VI permit took effect Oct 2025; three wells exist and a 2026 amendment uses new fracture-pressure test data. Injection awaits Stratos DAC startup, delayed by a commissioning problem; Oxy now targets end of 2026.

The Winkler County plant has run since 1Q 2025, and the MRV plan cites an issued RRC permit for BM AGI #1. Targa reports seven Delaware AGI wells but never names one at Bull Moose. Drilling and injection are unconfirmed.

Targa's Copperhead gas plant was still under construction as of August 2026, so no acid gas can be injected yet. NM OCD approved the Copperhead AGI No. 1 well in 2024-25, but no public record confirms it has been drilled.

Plant and Independence AGI #1 entered service in 2021; a second AGI well followed. Operator reported about 160,000 t CO2 sequestered through mid-2024 (about 100,000 t in 2023). Enterprise Products agreed to buy Pinon in Aug 2024.

CapturePoint's George Allen Unit and Ruth Hudson Lease in Gaines County have run CO2 floods since 2007 and 2012. The 2024 MRV plan describes active WAG injection using pipeline CO2 plus recycled CO2. No newer public update was found.

Delek Logistics finished drilling its first Libby acid gas injection well in Q1 2026. As of August 2026 the sour gas system was described as nearly complete and expected online in Q3-Q4 2026. No injection start has been announced.

No public source ties this facility to specific wells. Likely tied to Red Cedar's Colorado capture project, whose CO2 Kinder Morgan ships via Cortez for Permian Class II storage; Red Cedar describes it as operating, but no start date or confirmed link found.

Maljamar AGI #1 had begun injecting acid gas by October 2015, per an NMOCC order. AGI #2 was later added, and a 2017 OCD report shows both in use. The 2024 MRV plan says the plant operates two AGI wells. Exact start date unknown.

Not built. The Texas RRC Class VI list dated 9/22/2026 shows the Central Loving Facility (#58440) as Withdrawn; it was On Hold on 6/3/2026. The plan's two Class II AGI wells were only proposed, with no drilling record found.

Mongoose AGI #1 (Mitchell County, Ellenburger) was permitted by RRC in March 2023; the MRV plan says plant and well began operating in Aug 2023. RRC raised the rate to 19.5 MMcf/d in 2024, and the plant expanded in May 2025.

Oxy runs this as one project of 38 Slaughter and Levelland field units in Cochran, Hockley and Terry counties. CO2 flooding began in 1984. The 2025 MRV plan says CO2 injection continues in some units, using Bravo pipeline and recycled CO2.

The plan covers Driver AGI #1 in Midland County (RRC Class II permit 17479). The MRV plan listed its API number as TBD and said Targa intended to drill and inject in 2025. No later evidence of drilling or injection was found.

Northwind says it built and put into service two acid gas injection and sequestration wells at Titan (Lea County). NM regulators approved a third well, due in 2026. Start date and actual volumes are not public.

The Wellman Unit in Terry County, operated by CapturePoint, has run a CO2 flood since 1983. The 2024 MRV plan lists seven active CO2 injectors fed by pipeline and recycled CO2. No newer public update was found.

WC AGI #1 in Winkler County (API 42-495-34153, RRC permit 15903) has injected treated acid gas since 2019, per injection history through 2023. WC AGI #2 was permitted but not drilled. Nothing shows injection has stopped, but the newest evidence is from late 2024.

MRV plan says existing Aker No. 1 Class II well (Freestone County, Woodbine) has injected treated acid gas since April 2012 and remains active, with about 12 more years planned. No newer operator news found; separate 2027 capture expansion reported.

This CapturePoint CO2-EOR area in Ochiltree County has flooded since 2009 using Arkalon ethanol CO2. Supply was curtailed in 2020 and resumed when Arkalon's upgraded capture entered service in April 2023. A March 2024 45Q sale covered this CO2.

The plan covers a new Smith 3-21 well (EGLE Class II permit 61818, January 2025) for CO2 from Riverside's Turtle Lake capture at South Chester. It targeted readiness by March 2025. No confirmation of drilling or injection was found; trackers list it as in development.

Core CO2 Services (Core Energy subsidiary) has pending Class VI applications in Manistee County announced Aug 2025, and parent Core Energy has long run Niagaran reef CO2 EOR. No public source shows which wells this plan covers or that storage injection began.

summary: Reported 260,586 metric tons of CO2 stored in 2023 under Subpart RR. EPA's public data ends with reporting year 2023.

BKV says Cotton Cove first injected CO2 in April 2026 and began commercial operation by June 30, 2026. The Fort Worth Basin project, co-developed with Banpu Power US, uses a Class II well and expects about 32,000 t/yr.

CRC announced on May 26, 2026 that it had begun CO2 injection at Carbon TerraVault I (26R reservoir, Elk Hills), using CO2 from its Elk Hills cryogenic gas plant. The Q2 2026 results say CTV I is operating and injecting. Volumes were not disclosed.

facility_name: Dry Piney Jackalope Gas Processing Facility
summary: Still in permitting and financing. BLM and Wyoming siting approvals came in Dec 2025, with a two-year build expected to begin in 2026. In Sept 2026, DOE was still considering a loan. No evidence that construction or drilling began.

Four of six injectors are drilled, and Juniper I-1 holds Wyoming authorization to inject. Trailblazer pipeline deliveries from Nebraska ethanol plants began in fall 2025. A December 2025 report says the CO2 is now being stored at the hub. The exact first-injection month is unpublished.
Reported 70,046 metric tons of CO2 stored in 2023 under Subpart RR. EPA's public data ends with reporting year 2023.

Reported zero stored to EPA for 2022 and 2023, before its storage wells started. Basin Electric says injection into the Broom Creek sandstone near Beulah began in mid-February 2024 and passed 1 million metric tons by August 2024.

BKV's Eagle Ford CCS project near Freer began commercial operations June 30, 2026 at about 90,000 t/yr. The plan puts Lima Tango in McMullen County, near Freer, with the same operator and source; BKV doesn't name the well, so the match is inferred.

MRV plan says existing Class II well Lisbon Unit D-716 has injected acid gas (90% CO2) into the Leadville since June 2015 at about 750 Mscf/d, with planned increases. No operator confirmation of current injection; evidence is mostly the plan.

facility_name: Northeast Purdy Springer Unit (NEPSU)/South East Bradley A Unit (SEBAU)
summary: CO2 floods began at NEPSU in 1982 and SEBAU in 1997. The 2025 plan says only recycled CO2 has been injected since fresh supply ended in 2022, so no new CO2 is being stored; Subpart RR monitoring starts when a new supplier is found.

The plan converts an existing shut-in gas well in Bee County to inject treated acid gas from StarTex's Pawnee plant into the Sligo Formation. The RRC Class II permit was pending in August 2024. No public evidence of recompletion or injection was found.

The Rangely Weber Sand Unit CO2 flood has run since 1986; Scout Energy now operates it. As of April 2023 it injected about 160 MMscf/d, mostly recycled CO2. The plan expects the flood to continue for years. No newer status found.

On hold and in court. A district court voided Summit's North Dakota storage permits in 2026. Summit dropped sites #1 and #2 but is appealing to keep #3. Its pipeline now targets Wyoming storage instead. No injection wells are reported.

Still in planning. Minnkota added Reliant as capture partner and targets an investment decision in 2027; no construction was reported as of August 2026. The planned injectors are not completed, and the existing J-ROC1 test well is plugged and awaiting conversion.
